question: A software company needs to create short-lived test environments to test pull requests as part of its development process. Each test environment consists of a single Amazon EC2 instance that is in an Auto Scaling group. The test environments must be able to communicate with a central server to report test results. The central server is located in an on-premises data center. A solutions architect must implement a solution so that the company can create and delete test environments without any manual intervention. The company has created a transit gateway with a VPN attachment to the on-premises network. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that contains a transit gateway attachment and related routing configurations. Create a CloudFormation stack set that includes this template. Use CloudFormation StackSets to deploy a new stack for each VPC in the account. Deploy a new VPC for each test environment.
Create a single VPC for the test environments. Include a transit gateway attachment and related routing configurations. Use AWS CloudFormation to deploy all test environments into the VPC.

Create a new OU in AWS Organizations for testing. Create an AWS CioudFormation template that contains a VPC, necessary networking resources, a transit gateway attachment, and related routing configurations. Create a CloudFormation stack set that includes this template. Use CloudFormation StackSets for deployments into each account under the testing OU. Create a new account for each test environment.

Convert the test environment EC2 instances into Docker images. Use AWS CloudFormation to configure an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster in a new VPC, create a transit gateway attachment, and create related routing configurations. Use Kubernetes to manage the deployment and lifecycle of the test environments.

explanation: Chọn B vì một VPC duy nhất có transit gateway attachment và route cấu hình một lần, còn CloudFormation tạo/xóa từng môi trường tự động mà vẫn kết nối được on-premises. Tạo VPC/attachment cho mỗi môi trường hoặc mỗi account làm tăng chi phí, thời gian và giới hạn tài nguyên; EKS là phức tạp không cần thiết cho một EC2 instance.

learningAid.summary: Dùng một VPC và CloudFormation tạo/xóa môi trường test tự động.

translation.stem: Mỗi test environment là EC2 trong ASG, cần liên lạc server tại chỗ. Transit Gateway đã có VPN attachment. Cần tạo/xóa môi trường không thủ công, ít vận hành nhất.

options.text: Template chứa TGW attachment/routing, StackSets tạo stack và VPC mới cho từng environment.
Một VPC test có TGW attachment/routing; CloudFormation triển khai mọi environment trong VPC.
Tạo OU test, mỗi environment một account/VPC/attachment qua StackSets.
Đổi EC2 thành Docker, dựng EKS trong VPC mới và dùng Kubernetes quản lý lifecycle.

keywords.meaning: IaC quản lý resource
Hub kết nối nhiều VPC/mạng
Triển khai stack nhiều account/Region

learningAid.context: Môi trường ngắn hạn cần route tới on-premises qua TGW đã nối VPN.
constraints: Mỗi VPC/account thêm attachment và quota
EKS quá phức tạp cho một EC2
focusPoints: Tách shared network khỏi ephemeral workload.
Dùng một VPC nếu isolation không bắt buộc.

realWorld.scenario: CI tạo environment theo pull request rồi xóa.
realWorld.challenge: Dựng network attachment cho từng PR chậm và tốn.
realWorld.principle: Shared VPC với IaC giảm thời gian và connectivity duplication.
realWorld.takeaway: Dựng attachment một lần, CloudFormation quản lý workload.
realWorld.recommendation: Use subnet quotas, per-environment SGs/tags and automatic cleanup/TTL to prevent leakage.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Shared VPC reduces isolation; noisy-neighbor IP/security controls need explicit design.

reasoning.observation: Test environments are short-lived but all need the same on-prem route.
reasoning.inference: A shared VPC can reuse one existing TGW attachment and routes.

reasoning.observation: CloudFormation must create/delete environments automatically.
reasoning.inference: One stack per environment in that VPC minimizes lifecycle overhead.

correct.why: One test VPC with shared TGW attachment plus CloudFormation environments gives connectivity and least operations.

alternatives.failsBecause: An attachment per VPC adds provisioning, routes, quotas and deletion dependencies.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits strong network isolation per environment.

alternatives.failsBecause: An account per test is extreme overhead for a single EC2 environment.
EKS/containerization is unrelated complexity for one EC2 instance.

Reuse shared network instead of per-VPC attachment.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng shared hub connectivity; attachment is not free per VPC.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không tự tạo attachment/routes cho VPC mới.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng ephemeral declarative lifecycle.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không tự tạo network connectivity thiếu route/attachment.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng multi-account/Region deployment; unnecessary for same-account shared VPC.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không phải organization-wide preventive deny.

question: A company runs its sales reporting application in an AWS Region in the United States. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway Regional API and AWS Lambda functions to generate on-demand reports from data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The frontend of the application is hosted on Amazon S3 and is accessed by users through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company is using Amazon Route 53 as the DNS service for the domain. Route 53 is conﬁgured with a simple routing policy to route traﬃc to the API Gateway API. In the next 6 months, the company plans to expand operations to Europe. More than 90% of the database traﬃc is read-only traﬃc. The company has already deployed an API Gateway API and Lambda functions in the new Region. A solutions architect must design a solution that minimizes latency for users who download reports. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text: Use an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with full load to replicate the primary database in the original Region to the database in the new Region. Change the Route 53 record to latency-based routing to connect to the API Gateway API.

Use an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with full load plus change data capture (CDC) to replicate the primary database in the original Region to the database in the new Region. Change the Route 53 record to geolocation routing to connect to the API Gateway API.
Configure a cross-Region read replica for the RDS database in the new Region Change the Route 53 record to latency-based routing to connect to the API Gateway API.
Configure a cross-Region read replica for the RDS database in the new Region. Change the Route 53 record to geolocation routing to connect to the API Gateway API.

explanation: Chọn C vì read replica liên vùng cung cấp dữ liệu cập nhật cho phần lớn traffic đọc, còn latency-based routing đưa người dùng đến API Region gần nhất. DMS full load không duy trì thay đổi; geolocation định tuyến theo vị trí chứ không đo độ trễ, và read replica là phù hợp hơn cho 90% đọc.

learningAid.summary: Dùng read replica liên Region và latency routing cho traffic đọc.

translation.stem: Ứng dụng báo cáo ở Mỹ dùng API Gateway/Lambda đọc RDS MySQL; sắp mở châu Âu, hơn 90% database traffic là đọc và API Region mới đã có. Cần giảm latency tải report.

options.text: DMS full load sang database mới và Route 53 latency routing tới API.
DMS full load plus CDC và Route 53 geolocation routing.
RDS cross-Region read replica và latency-based routing tới API.
Read replica và geolocation routing tới API.

keywords.meaning: Bản sao phục vụ đọc
Định tuyến theo độ trễ
Sao chép thay đổi liên tục

learningAid.context: API/database châu Âu đã có và phần lớn traffic chỉ đọc.
constraints: Full load không giữ thay đổi
Geolocation không đo latency thực tế
focusPoints: Ghép read-heavy với read replica.
Chọn routing policy theo latency.

realWorld.scenario: Công ty Mỹ mở dashboard báo cáo cho khách châu Âu.
realWorld.challenge: Đọc database xuyên đại dương làm tải chậm.
realWorld.principle: Replica giảm khoảng cách dữ liệu; latency DNS chọn API gần.
realWorld.takeaway: Tách read path theo Region và giữ write source rõ ràng.
realWorld.recommendation: Route reads explicitly, monitor replica lag and keep writes on primary with clear consistency expectations.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Cross-Region replication lag means read-after-write may be stale; DNS caches influence routing.

reasoning.observation: Over 90% of database traffic is read-only and Europe has an API deployment.
reasoning.inference: A cross-Region read replica serves local reads.

reasoning.observation: Goal is lowest latency, not geographic policy.
reasoning.inference: Latency-based routing is more direct than geolocation.

correct.why: RDS cross-Region read replica plus latency routing sends users to the nearest API/read path.

alternatives.failsBecause: DMS full load does not replicate ongoing changes, so the report database becomes stale.
CDC maintains data but geolocation chooses location, not measured latency.
Read replica is right, but geolocation is less precise for latency optimization.

examTraps.avoid: Read replica is the scaling primitive.
Chọn latency routing, không geolocation.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng read scaling/DR; replica is read-only.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cung cấp multi-writer và có replica lag.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng measured client-to-Region latency; not data replication.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không chuyển database writes hoặc consistency.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng heterogeneous replication; needs task/target.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không tự tạo initial/restorable database nếu chỉ chạy CDC.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: Read-heavy đa Region: read replica cho dữ liệu, latency routing cho endpoint.

question: A solutions architect needs to migrate an on-premises legacy application to AWS. The application runs on two servers behind a load balancer. The application requires a license ﬁle that is associated with the MAC address of the server's network adapter It takes the software vendor 12 hours to send new license ﬁles. The application also uses conﬁguration ﬁles with a static IP address to access a database server, host names are not supported. Given these requirements, which combination of steps should be taken to implement highly available architecture for the application servers in AWS? (Choose two.)

options.text: Create a pool of ENIs. Request license files from the vendor for the pool, and store the license files in Amazon S3. Create a bootstrap automation script to download a license file and attach the corresponding ENI to an Amazon EC2 instance.

Create a pool of ENIs. Request license files from the vendor for the pool, store the license files on an Amazon EC2 instance. Create an AMI from the instance and use this AMI for all future EC2 instances.
Create a bootstrap automation script to request a new license file from the vendor.When the response is received, apply the license file to an Amazon EC2 instance.
Edit the bootstrap automation script to read the database server IP address from the AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store, and inject the value into the local configuration files.
Edit an Amazon EC2 instance to include the database server IP address in the configuration files and re-create the AMI to use for all future EC2 stances.

explanation: A cấp trước pool ENI có license tương ứng và bootstrap gắn ENI/ tải license khi instance khởi động, đáp ứng MAC cố định mà không chờ vendor 12 giờ. D lấy IP database từ Parameter Store để cấu hình động; AMI dùng chung license hoặc IP tĩnh không phù hợp, còn yêu cầu license mỗi lần khởi động gây downtime.

learningAid.summary: Giữ license gắn MAC bằng pool ENI và cấu hình IP động bằng Parameter Store.

translation.stem: Ứng dụng legacy cần license gắn MAC network adapter, vendor mất 12 giờ cấp lại; config dùng IP database cố định. Cần HA trên AWS. Chọn hai bước.

options.text: Pool ENI, xin license tương ứng lưu S3, bootstrap tải license và attach ENI tương ứng.
Pool ENI, lưu license trên EC2, tạo AMI dùng cho mọi instance.
Bootstrap yêu cầu license mới từ vendor rồi áp vào EC2.
Bootstrap đọc IP database từ Parameter Store và chèn vào config.
Nhúng IP database vào config và tạo AMI dùng cho mọi EC2.

keywords.meaning: Elastic Network Interface có MAC
Script khi instance khởi tạo
Kho parameter managed

learningAid.context: Instance có thể thay thế nhưng phần mềm khóa license theo MAC và không hỗ trợ hostname.
constraints: Xin license lúc boot mất 12 giờ
AMI dùng chung không đảm bảo MAC
IP cứng khó thay đổi
focusPoints: Chuẩn bị license trước.
Đưa config môi trường ra khỏi AMI.

realWorld.scenario: Ứng dụng thương mại cũ chạy trong ASG.
realWorld.challenge: Instance chết phải thay nhanh dù vendor cấp license chậm.
realWorld.principle: Pool ENI biến MAC/license thành tài nguyên dự phòng.
realWorld.takeaway: Chuẩn bị license và bootstrap ghép đúng ENI.
realWorld.recommendation: Automate ENI lease/release, license encryption, and health checks for one active attachment per instance.
realWorld.tradeoffs: ENI pool size and vendor license count cap scaling; static IP creates database failover coupling.

reasoning.observation: License is tied to MAC and vendor takes 12 hours.
reasoning.inference: Pre-provisioned ENI pool maps known MACs to license files.

reasoning.observation: Database only exposes static IP.
reasoning.inference: Bootstrap can inject a Parameter Store value per instance without baking it into AMI.

correct.why: ENI/license pool and bootstrap attachment let replacement instances start without vendor delay.
Parameter Store decouples database IP configuration from immutable AMI.

alternatives.failsBecause: Storing licenses on one EC2/AMI does not bind each future instance to the matching ENI/MAC and risks secret sprawl.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits immutable shared assets that are not hardware-bound.

alternatives.failsBecause: Requesting a license at launch introduces 12-hour unavailability.

alternatives.whenFits: Fits truly immutable IP-only legacy environments.

answerAnalysis.combinationLogic: A pre-provisions MAC-bound license identity through ENIs, while D injects the non-hostname database IP; both hardware identity and runtime configuration are required.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng stable MAC identity; not a general storage volume.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không thay vendor license entitlement; MAC pool phải được cấp phép.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng durable license artifact; protect with encryption/policy.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cung cấp POSIX locking hoặc local filesystem latency.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: License theo MAC thì pool ENI; IP legacy thì inject từ Parameter Store lúc boot.

question: An entertainment company recently launched a new game. To ensure a good experience for players during the launch period, the company deployed a static quantity of 12 r6g.16xlarge (memory optimized) Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer. The company's operations team used the Amazon CloudWatch agent and a custom metric to include memory utilization in its monitoring strategy. Analysis of the CloudWatch metrics from the launch period showed consumption at about one quarter of the CPU and memory that the company expected. Initial demand for the game has subsided and has become more variable. The company decides to use an Auto Scaling group that monitors the CPU and memory consumption to dynamically scale the instance ﬂeet. A solutions architect needs to conﬁgure the Auto Scaling group to meet demand in the most cost-effective way. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text: Configure the Auto Scaling group to deploy c6g.4xlarge (compute optimized) instances. Configure a minimum capacity of 3, a desired capacity of 3, and a maximum capacity of 12.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to deploy m6g.4xlarge (general purpose) instances. Configure a minimum capacity of 3, a desired capacity of 3, and a maximum capacity of 12.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to deploy r6g.4xlarge (memory optimized) instances. Configure a minimum capacity of 3, a desired capacity of 3, and a maximum capacity of 12.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to deploy r6g.8xlarge (memory optimized) instances. Configure a minimum capacity of 2, a desired capacity of 2, and a maximum capacity of 6.

explanation: Chọn C vì bốn r6g.4xlarge tương đương tổng CPU/memory với một r6g.16xlarge, nên ba instance ban đầu phản ánh mức tiêu thụ một phần tư và có thể scale tới 12. m6g có tỷ lệ memory khác, còn r6g.8xlarge chỉ cho tối đa sáu máy và không bám sát kích thước đã đo.

learningAid.summary: Rightsize theo metric và giữ họ instance memory-optimized.

translation.stem: Game dùng 12 r6g.16xlarge nhưng CPU/memory chỉ khoảng một phần tư; tải biến động và cần ASG scale theo CPU/memory. Cấu hình tiết kiệm nhất?

options.text: c6g.4xlarge, min/desired 3, max 12.
m6g.4xlarge, min/desired 3, max 12.
r6g.4xlarge, min/desired 3, max 12.
r6g.8xlarge, min/desired 2, max 6.

keywords.meaning: Họ instance memory optimized
Họ instance general purpose
Min/desired/max instance

constraints: Họ compute/general có thể thiếu memory
r6g.8xlarge giới hạn scale và không khớp
focusPoints: Tính tổng tài nguyên sau rightsizing.

realWorld.scenario: Nhà phát hành game giảm tải sau launch.
realWorld.challenge: 12 máy lớn cố định lãng phí khi người chơi giảm.

realWorld.takeaway: Chọn r6g.4xlarge để chia nhỏ capacity tương đương.
realWorld.recommendation: Validate with memory pressure/load tests and use target tracking on CPU plus custom memory metric.

reasoning.observation: Measured CPU and memory are about one quarter of 12 r6g.16xlarge capacity.
reasoning.inference: Four r6g.4xlarge roughly replace one original size while preserving memory-optimized ratio.

reasoning.observation: Demand became variable and ASG should scale.
reasoning.inference: Min/desired 3 and max 12 gives rightsized baseline and burst headroom.

alternatives.failsBecause: c6g changes to compute-optimized and may undersupply memory.
m6g has a different CPU:memory ratio and may not preserve the observed memory requirement.
r6g.8xlarge uses larger units and max six, reducing granularity and not matching the measured quarter.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits workloads needing larger per-instance memory.

examTraps.avoid: Tính theo cùng r6g ratio, không chỉ vCPU.
Không đổi family nếu memory remains relevant.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng memory-optimized workload.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không tối ưu CPU-bound workload khi memory không còn bottleneck.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng balanced CPU/memory; not equivalent ratio.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không giữ memory/CPU ratio của memory-optimized r6g workload.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng min/desired/max and target tracking.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không chia CIDR hay replicate stateful data.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: Rightsize cùng họ memory: chia r6g.16xlarge thành r6g.4xlarge rồi scale 3–12.

question: A company is launching a new online game on Amazon EC2 instances. The game must be available globally. The company plans to run the game in three AWS Regions us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1. The game's leaderboards, player inventory and event status must be available across Regions. A solutions architect must design a solution that will give any Region the ability to scale to handle the load of all Regions. Additionally, users must automatically connect to the Region that provides the least latency. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Create an EC2 Spot Fleet. Attach the Spot Fleet to a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each Region. Create an AWS Global Accelerator IP address that points to the NLB. Create an Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing entry for the Global Accelerator IP address. Save the game metadata to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in each Region. Set up a read replica in the other Regions.

Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances Attach the Auto Scaling group to a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each Region. For each Region, create an Amazon Route 53 entry that uses geoproximity routing and points to the NLB in that Region. Save the game metadata to MySQL databases on EC2 instances in each Region. Set up replication between the database EC2 instances in each Region.

Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Attach the Auto Scaling group to a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each Region. For each Region, create an Amazon Route 53 entry that uses latency-based routing and points to the NLB in that Region. Save the game metadata to an Amazon DynamoDB global table.

Use EC2 Global View. Deploy the EC2 instances to each Region. Attach the instances to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Deploy a DNS server on an EC2 instance in each Region. Set up custom logic on each DNS server to redirect the user to the Region that provides the lowest latency. Save the game metadata to an Amazon Aurora global database.

explanation: Chọn C vì Auto Scaling cho phép mỗi Region tăng đủ sức tải, Route 53 latency routing chọn Region gần nhất, và DynamoDB global table cung cấp dữ liệu đa Region. Spot Fleet có rủi ro gián đoạn và RDS read replica không hỗ trợ trạng thái ghi toàn cầu; tự dựng DNS/replication tăng vận hành.

learningAid.summary: Kết hợp Auto Scaling, latency routing và DynamoDB global tables cho game toàn cầu.

translation.stem: Game chạy EC2 ở ba Region; leaderboard, inventory và event status phải dùng chung; mỗi Region có thể gánh toàn bộ tải; user tự đến Region ít latency. Giải pháp ít vận hành nhất?

options.text: Spot Fleet/NLB/Global Accelerator, Route 53 latency tới Global Accelerator, RDS MySQL mỗi Region với read replica.
ASG/NLB, Route 53 geoproximity, MySQL trên EC2 mỗi Region và tự replication.
ASG/NLB mỗi Region, Route 53 latency routing và DynamoDB global table.
EC2 Global View, DNS server tự viết mỗi Region và Aurora global database.

keywords.meaning: Bảng active-active đa Region
Chọn endpoint theo độ trễ
Fleet EC2 tự co giãn

learningAid.context: Game state phải đọc/ghi từ mọi Region và compute scale theo tải.
constraints: RDS read replica không xử lý ghi đa Region
DNS tự viết và EC2 DB tăng vận hành
focusPoints: Tìm datastore multi-Region native.
Phân biệt latency routing và geoproximity.

realWorld.scenario: Game online ra mắt đồng thời toàn cầu.
realWorld.challenge: Người chơi phải thấy state dù được định tuyến Region nào.
realWorld.principle: Global tables và managed routing tránh tự xây replication.
realWorld.takeaway: Kết hợp ASG, NLB, latency DNS và global table.
realWorld.recommendation: Define conflict resolution/idempotency for global writes and use regional health checks in routing.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Global tables are eventually consistent/conflict-sensitive; DNS TTL and write conflicts affect gameplay.

reasoning.observation: All Regions must read/write game state and any Region must handle all load.
reasoning.inference: DynamoDB global tables provide multi-Region state; ASGs scale regional compute.

reasoning.observation: Users should reach lowest latency Region.
reasoning.inference: Route 53 latency routing chooses among Regional NLB endpoints.

correct.why: ASG/NLB per Region, latency routing and DynamoDB global table provide active-active scale and shared state.

alternatives.failsBecause: Spot Fleet is not the stated Auto Scaling design, RDS read replicas do not provide multi-Region writes, and extra GA/DNS layering is unnecessary.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits stateless compute with tolerant interruption and read-heavy RDS.

alternatives.failsBecause: Geoproximity is geography-based and self-managed MySQL replication on EC2 is high operational risk.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits explicitly geographic routing and custom database control.

alternatives.failsBecause: Custom DNS servers/EC2 logic add operations; Aurora global database is not the simplest fit for global writes here.

examTraps.avoid: Database must support active-active writes.
Geoproximity/custom DNS are not necessary.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng active-active multi-Region key-value; not arbitrary relational transactions.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cung cấp relational joins như SQL.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng DNS latency selection; not instant health failover alone.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không chuyển database writes hoặc consistency.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng static anycast acceleration; not needed when latency DNS is sufficient.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cache content hoặc tạo DR Region.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: Game state đa Region + scale: global table, ASG/NLB và latency routing.

question: A company wants to use Amazon S3 to back up its on-premises ﬁle storage solution. The company’s on-premises ﬁle storage solution supports NFS, and the company wants its new solution to support NFS. The company wants to archive the backup ﬁles after 5 days. If the company needs archived ﬁles for disaster recovery, the company is willing to wait a few days for the retrieval of those ﬁles. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.text: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway that is associated with an S3 bucket. Move the files from the on-premises file storage solution to the file gateway. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 5 days.

Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is associated with an S3 bucket. Move the files from the on-premises file storage solution to the volume gateway. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 days.

Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway that is associated with an S3 bucket. Move the files from the on-premises file storage solution to the tape gateway. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 5 days.

Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway that is associated with an S3 bucket. Move the files from the on-premises file storage solution to the file gateway. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to move the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 5 days.

explanation: Chọn D vì file gateway cung cấp giao thức NFS cho hệ thống hiện hữu và S3 Lifecycle chuyển dữ liệu sang Glacier Deep Archive sau năm ngày, phù hợp việc chờ vài ngày khi khôi phục. Standard-IA không tối ưu lưu trữ dài hạn; volume/tape gateway không cung cấp NFS trực tiếp như yêu cầu.

learningAid.summary: Dùng File Gateway NFS với lifecycle sang Glacier Deep Archive.

translation.stem: Công ty muốn backup file storage NFS tại chỗ lên S3, vẫn hỗ trợ NFS. File sau năm ngày được archive; DR có thể chờ vài ngày. Giải pháp rẻ nhất?

options.text: File Gateway tới S3 và lifecycle sang Standard-IA sau 5 ngày.
Volume Gateway tới S3 và lifecycle sang Glacier Deep Archive sau 5 ngày.
Tape Gateway tới S3 và lifecycle sang Standard-IA sau 5 ngày.
File Gateway tới S3, dùng NFS và lifecycle sang Glacier Deep Archive sau 5 ngày.

keywords.meaning: Gateway file NFS/SMB đưa dữ liệu S3
Storage archive rẻ, khôi phục lâu
Tự chuyển storage class theo tuổi

learningAid.context: Nguồn NFS và dữ liệu backup ít truy cập sau ngày thứ năm.
constraints: Standard-IA đắt hơn archive dài hạn
Volume/Tape không cung cấp NFS phù hợp
focusPoints: Ghép protocol với Storage Gateway.
Chọn class theo retrieval requirement.

realWorld.scenario: Doanh nghiệp lưu backup file cho DR dài hạn.
realWorld.challenge: Chi phí quan trọng hơn tốc độ restore.
realWorld.principle: File Gateway giữ interface NFS, Deep Archive tối ưu retention.
realWorld.takeaway: Dùng lifecycle chuyển tự động sau giai đoạn nóng.
realWorld.recommendation: Set minimum object age, retention/legal hold and restore drills before relying on archive.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Deep Archive retrieval latency/fees and gateway cache capacity affect DR runbooks.

reasoning.observation: Source supports NFS and archived files may take days to retrieve.
reasoning.inference: File Gateway exposes NFS and Glacier Deep Archive minimizes long-term storage cost.

reasoning.observation: Archive happens after five days.
reasoning.inference: S3 Lifecycle transitions objects automatically.

correct.why: File Gateway preserves NFS; Deep Archive after five days matches low retrieval urgency and cost.

alternatives.failsBecause: Standard-IA is warmer and more expensive than Deep Archive for multi-day archive.
Volume Gateway presents block storage, not the required NFS file interface.
Tape Gateway is virtual tape, not an NFS file share, and Standard-IA is not cheapest archive.

examTraps.avoid: Chọn File Gateway, không Volume/Tape.
Chọn Deep Archive, không Standard-IA.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng NFS/SMB backed by S3; not block/tape interface.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cung cấp database/block-storage semantics.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng long-term infrequent archive; retrieval is slow.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không phù hợp restore tức thời hoặc truy cập thường xuyên.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng automatic storage class transition; not backup scheduler.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không phát hiện deletion realtime.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: NFS + retrieval chậm chấp nhận: File Gateway và Lifecycle sang Deep Archive.

question: A company is using AWS Organizations with a multi-account architecture. The company's current security conﬁguration for the account architecture includes SCPs, resource-based policies, identity-based policies, trust policies, and session policies. A solutions architect needs to allow an IAM user in Account A to assume a role in Account B. Which combination of steps must the solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose three.)

options.text: Configure the SCP for Account A to allow the action.
Configure the resource-based policies to allow the action.
Configure the identity-based policy on the user in Account A to allow the action.
Configure the identity-based policy on the user in Account B to allow the action.
Configure the trust policy on the target role in Account B to allow the action.
Configure the session policy to allow the action and to be passed programmatically by the GetSessionToken API operation.

explanation: A bảo đảm SCP của Account A không chặn STS, C cấp quyền sts:AssumeRole cho user nguồn, và E cho phép principal đó trong trust policy của role đích. Policy của user ở Account B không cấp quyền cho user A, resource policy thông thường không thay thế trust policy, và session policy không phải bước bắt buộc.

learningAid.summary: Nắm đủ lớp quyền khi IAM user assume role cross-account.

translation.stem: Organization có SCP, resource/identity/trust/session policies. Cần cho IAM user Account A assume role Account B. Chọn ba bước.

options.text: Cấu hình SCP Account A cho phép action.
Cấu hình resource-based policy cho phép action.
Identity policy trên user Account A cho phép action.
Identity policy trên user Account B cho phép action.
Trust policy role đích Account B cho phép action.
Session policy cho phép action và truyền qua GetSessionToken.

keywords.meaning: STS đổi identity sang role
Xác định ai được assume role
Quyền gắn với user/role

learningAid.context: User nguồn account A cần nhận role trong account B.
constraints: User policy account B không cấp quyền cho A
Session/resource policy không thay trust cơ bản
focusPoints: Kiểm tra caller và target role.
Nhớ SCP là giới hạn tối đa.

realWorld.scenario: Đội vận hành trung tâm assume role vào workload accounts.
realWorld.challenge: Thiếu một lớp policy gây AccessDenied.
realWorld.principle: Cross-account assume role cần allow ở identity và trust.
realWorld.takeaway: Cấp quyền nguồn, trust đích và bảo đảm SCP không deny.
realWorld.recommendation: Use external ID for third-party access, MFA conditions and CloudTrail AssumeRole auditing.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Role sessions inherit boundaries/conditions; overly broad trust is a privilege-escalation risk.

reasoning.observation: Caller is an IAM user in Account A, target is a role in B.
reasoning.inference: Caller identity policy and target trust policy are the core cross-account allows.

reasoning.observation: SCPs constrain, but do not grant, permissions.
reasoning.inference: Account A SCP must not block STS; Account B role trust must name the principal/provider.

correct.why: Account A SCP must permit the action (no enclosing deny).
User identity policy must allow sts:AssumeRole.
Target role trust policy must allow the Account A principal.

alternatives.failsBecause: AssumeRole authorization uses identity and trust policies, not a generic resource policy in this setup.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits resource-based access to supported resources.

alternatives.failsBecause: User policy in Account B does not authorize a caller in Account A.
Session policy/GetSessionToken is not a required assume-role step and can further restrict permissions.

answerAnalysis.combinationLogic: A ensures the organization boundary does not deny, C grants the caller action, and E trusts the caller at the target role.

examTraps.avoid: Kiểm tra cả source và target.
SCP allow is necessary as boundary, not sufficient grant.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng target role to name trusted principal.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cấp quyền cho caller nếu identity policy thiếu.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng caller to allow sts:AssumeRole.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không thay target role trust policy.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng maximum permission boundary; never grants by itself.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cấp quyền; vẫn cần identity/resource allow.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: Cross-account AssumeRole cần source identity allow, target trust allow và SCP không deny.

question: A solutions architect is reviewing a company's process for taking snapshots of Amazon RDS DB instances. The company takes automatic snapshots every day and retains the snapshots for 7 days. The solutions architect needs to recommend a solution that takes snapshots every 6 hours and retains the snapshots for 30 days. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage all of its AWS accounts. The company needs a consolidated view of the health of the RDS snapshots. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Turn on the cross-account management feature in AWS Backup. Create a backup plan that specifies the frequency and retention requirements. Add a tag to the DB instances. Apply the backup plan by using tags. Use AWS Backup to monitor the status of the backups.

Turn on the cross-account management feature in Amazon RDS. Create a snapshot global policy that specifies the frequency and retention requirements. Use the RDS console in the management account to monitor the status of the backups.

Turn on the cross-account management feature in AWS CloudFormation. From the management account, deploy a CloudFormation stack set that contains a backup plan from AWS Backup that specifies the frequency and retention requirements. Create an AWS Lambda function in the management account to monitor the status of the backups. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule in each account to run the Lambda function on a schedule.

Configure AWS Backup in each account. Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager lifecycle policy that specifies the frequency and retention requirements. Specify the DB instances as the target resource Use the Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager console in each member account to monitor the status of the backups.

explanation: Chọn A vì AWS Backup hỗ trợ quản lý liên tài khoản, backup plan theo lịch/retention bằng tag và dashboard tập trung theo dõi tình trạng. RDS không có cross-account management như mô tả; CloudFormation/Lambda tự xây dựng nhiều thành phần, còn DLM không quản lý snapshot RDS.

learningAid.summary: Dùng AWS Backup quản lý lịch, retention và trạng thái RDS tập trung.

translation.stem: Công ty cần snapshot RDS mỗi 6 giờ, giữ 30 ngày, quản lý nhiều account bằng Organizations và có consolidated health view. Giải pháp ít vận hành nhất?

options.text: Bật cross-account management AWS Backup, tạo plan theo lịch/retention, gắn tag và theo dõi bằng AWS Backup.
Bật cross-account management RDS và tạo snapshot global policy.
Dùng StackSets backup plan và Lambda/EventBridge tự monitor.
Cấu hình Backup mỗi account, dùng DLM lifecycle và monitor từng account.

keywords.meaning: Lịch, vault và retention AWS Backup
Quản lý backup nhiều account
Điểm có thể phục hồi

learningAid.context: RDS snapshot cần lịch dày và quan sát tập trung.
constraints: DLM không quản lý RDS
Tự dựng Lambda nhiều thành phần
Monitor từng account không consolidated
focusPoints: Dùng AWS Backup cho database governance.
Gán resource bằng tag.

realWorld.scenario: Đội platform quản lý backup cho hàng trăm database.
realWorld.challenge: Không muốn duy trì scheduler/dashboard riêng từng account.
realWorld.principle: AWS Backup có policy, governance và monitoring tích hợp.
realWorld.takeaway: Tập trung lịch/retention bằng backup plan.
realWorld.recommendation: Use delegated admin, vault lock and periodic restore tests; tag ownership must be governed.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Cross-account backup copies incur storage/transfer cost and KMS permissions must be correct.

reasoning.observation: Need every six hours, 30-day retention, multi-account management and one health view.
reasoning.inference: AWS Backup plan and cross-account management map directly to all four.

reasoning.observation: Resource selection can use tags.
reasoning.inference: No per-account custom scheduler or DLM is required.

correct.why: AWS Backup central management, tag assignment, schedule/retention and monitoring provide the complete managed workflow.

alternatives.failsBecause: RDS does not offer the described cross-account management/snapshot global policy control.
StackSets plus Lambda/EventBridge recreates capabilities with more components and custom monitoring.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits when native monitoring is insufficient.

alternatives.failsBecause: DLM is for EBS, not RDS DB instances, and monitoring remains per account.

answerAnalysis.combinationLogic: A single AWS Backup plan supplies schedule, retention, cross-account management, tag assignment, and consolidated monitoring.

examTraps.avoid: Dùng AWS Backup monitoring, không từng account.
DLM không phải RDS service.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng cross-account plans/vaults and monitoring.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cung cấp replication realtime hoặc tự chuyển DNS.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng EBS snapshots, not RDS backup plans.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không khôi phục full RDS/EC2 configuration.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng deployment replication; not necessary for native Backup governance.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không cung cấp RDS backup health view; AWS Backup plan mới quản lý lịch/retention.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: RDS backup policy đa account: AWS Backup plan theo tag + cross-account management.

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage a multi-account structure. The company has hundreds of AWS accounts and expects the number of accounts to increase. The company is building a new application that uses Docker images. The company will push the Docker images to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Only accounts that are within the company’s organization should have access to the images. The company has a CI/CD process that runs frequently. The company wants to retain all the tagged images. However, the company wants to retain only the ﬁve most recent untagged images. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.text: Create a private repository in Amazon ECR. Create a permissions policy for the repository that allows only required ECR operations. Include a condition to allow the ECR operations if the value of the aws:PrincipalOrglD condition key is equal to the ID of the company’s organization. Add a lifecycle rule to the ECR repository that deletes all untagged images over the count of five

Create a public repository in Amazon ECR. Create an IAM role in the ECR account. Set permissions so that any account can assume the role if the value of the aws:PrincipalOrglD condition key is equal to the ID of the company’s organization. Add a lifecycle rule to the ECR repository that deletes all untagged images over the count of five.

Create a private repository in Amazon ECR. Create a permissions policy for the repository that includes only required ECR operations. Include a condition to allow the ECR operations for all account IDs in the organization Schedule a daily Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that deletes all untagged images over the count of five.

Create a public repository in Amazon ECR. Configure Amazon ECR to use an interface VPC endpoint with an endpoint policy that includes the required permissions for images that the company needs to pull. Include a condition to allow the ECR operations for all account IDs in the company’s organization. Schedule a daily Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that deletes all untagged images over the count of five.

explanation: Chọn A vì ECR private repository policy dùng aws:PrincipalOrgID để cho mọi account trong organization truy cập mà không mở internet, đồng thời lifecycle rule giữ toàn bộ tagged image và chỉ giữ năm untagged gần nhất. Public repository làm lộ image; Lambda/EventBridge tự xóa làm tăng vận hành và dễ sai phạm vi.

learningAid.summary: Dùng ECR policy theo organization và lifecycle cho untagged image.

translation.stem: Organization có hàng trăm account đẩy Docker image thường xuyên. Chỉ account trong organization được truy cập; giữ mọi tagged image nhưng chỉ năm untagged mới nhất. Giải pháp ít vận hành?

options.text: Private ECR policy cho phép khi aws:PrincipalOrgID đúng và lifecycle xóa untagged vượt năm.
Public ECR, role assume nếu PrincipalOrgID đúng và lifecycle xóa untagged.
Private ECR policy theo account IDs và Lambda hằng ngày xóa untagged.
Public ECR với VPC endpoint policy và Lambda xóa untagged.

keywords.meaning: Policy truy cập container registry
Điều kiện principal thuộc organization
Tự dọn image theo tag/count

learningAid.context: Nhiều account build/pull image từ registry trung tâm.
constraints: Public repository lộ image
Account IDs phải bảo trì
Lambda cleanup tăng vận hành
focusPoints: Dùng PrincipalOrgID thay danh sách account.
Dùng lifecycle native theo count.

realWorld.scenario: Các account CI/CD chia sẻ image private.
realWorld.challenge: Account thay đổi và untagged image tăng nhanh.
realWorld.principle: ECR policy/lifecycle native là control declarative.
realWorld.takeaway: Private repository + organization condition + lifecycle count.
realWorld.recommendation: Add immutable tags/digest deployment and test lifecycle preview before enabling deletion.
realWorld.tradeoffs: Lifecycle deletion is irreversible; CI tag discipline and repository policy must be reviewed.

reasoning.observation: Only organization accounts may access a private ECR repository.
reasoning.inference: aws:PrincipalOrgID expresses that boundary without maintaining account IDs.

reasoning.observation: Keep all tagged images but only five untagged.
reasoning.inference: ECR lifecycle rule can count untagged images natively.

correct.why: Private repository policy gates by organization ID and lifecycle deletes untagged images over five.

alternatives.failsBecause: Public repository violates the private access requirement even with a restrictive role.
Account ID lists drift as organization grows and Lambda cleanup adds operations.
Public ECR remains publicly exposed; endpoint policy does not make repository private.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits endpoint-restricted private pulls if repository is private.

examTraps.avoid: Private repo + PrincipalOrgID.
Lifecycle filter/count, not daily Lambda.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng cross-account repository access.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không quản lý image retention/tag deletion.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng organization-wide condition; not account enumeration.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không kiểm soát tag/retention; chỉ giới hạn principal context.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng tag status/count retention; not arbitrary metadata.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không enforce repository account membership.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: Private ECR dùng PrincipalOrgID; lifecycle giữ toàn bộ tagged và năm untagged mới nhất.

question: A solutions architect is determining the DNS strategy for an existing VPC. The VPC is provisioned to use the 10.24.34.0/24 CIDR block. The VPC also uses Amazon Route 53 Resolver for DNS. New requirements mandate that DNS queries must use private hosted zones. Additionally instances that have public IP addresses must receive corresponding public hostnames Which solution will meet these requirements to ensure that the domain names are correctly resolved within the VPC?

options.text: Create a private hosted zone. Activate the enableDnsSupport attribute and the enableDnsHostnames attribute for the VPC. Update the VPC DHCP options set to include domain-name-servers=10.24.34.2.

Create a private hosted zone Associate the private hosted zone with the VPC. Activate the enableDnsSupport attribute and the enableDnsHostnames attribute for the VPC. Create a new VPC DHCP options set, and configure domain-name- servers=AmazonProvidedDNS. Associate the new DHCP options set with the VPC.

question: An online survey company runs its application in the AWS Cloud. The application is distributed and consists of microservices that run in an automatically scaled Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The ECS cluster is a target for an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB is a custom origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company has a survey that contains sensitive data. The sensitive data must be encrypted when it moves through the application. The application's data-handling microservice is the only microservice that should be able to decrypt the data Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text: Create a symmetric AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is dedicated to the data-handling microservice. Create a field-level encryption profile and a configuration. Associate the KMS key and the configuration with the CloudFront cache behavior.

Create an RSA key pair that is dedicated to the data-handing microservice. Upload the public key to the CloudFront distribution. Create a field-level encryption profile and a configuration. Add the configuration to the CloudFront cache behavior.

Create a symmetric AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is dedicated to the data-handling microservice. Create a Lambda@Edge function. Program the function to use the KMS key to encrypt the sensitive data.

Create an RSA key pair that is dedicated to the data-handling microservice. Create a Lambda@Edge function. Program the function to use the private key of the RSA key pair to encrypt the sensitive data.

explanation: Chọn B vì CloudFront field-level encryption dùng public RSA key để mã hóa trường nhạy cảm, chỉ microservice giữ private key mới giải mã được. KMS symmetric key không được CloudFront field-level encryption dùng theo cách này; Lambda@Edge với private key hoặc KMS tạo thêm rủi ro và không phù hợp mô hình mã hóa trường.

learningAid.summary: Dùng CloudFront field-level encryption với RSA key chỉ service đích giữ private key.

translation.stem: Ứng dụng survey microservices qua CloudFront/ALB/ECS có dữ liệu nhạy cảm; chỉ microservice xử lý dữ liệu được giải mã. Giải pháp nào?

options.text: KMS symmetric key, field-level encryption profile/config và gắn vào cache behavior.
RSA key pair riêng, upload public key lên CloudFront, tạo field-level encryption profile/config và gắn cache behavior.
KMS key và Lambda@Edge dùng key mã hóa dữ liệu.
RSA key pair và Lambda@Edge dùng private key mã hóa dữ liệu.

keywords.meaning: Mã hóa riêng trường nhạy cảm
Khóa công khai dùng mã hóa
Khóa bí mật chỉ service đích giữ

learningAid.context: Sensitive form data đi qua edge nhưng chỉ backend chuyên trách đọc plaintext.
constraints: KMS/Lambda@Edge không phải FLE phù hợp
Private key không để ở edge
focusPoints: Dùng public key ở edge, private key ở consumer.
Phân biệt field encryption với TLS.

realWorld.scenario: Khách hàng nhập dữ liệu nhạy cảm vào survey form.
realWorld.challenge: Nhiều microservice xử lý nhưng chỉ một được đọc trường.
realWorld.principle: Asymmetric field encryption giới hạn khả năng giải mã.
realWorld.takeaway: CloudFront mã hóa bằng public key, backend giữ private key.
realWorld.recommendation: Rotate public keys, keep private key in service KMS/HSM workflow and log decrypt authorization.
realWorld.tradeoffs: FLE protects selected fields but key rotation, payload limits and downstream schema add complexity.

reasoning.observation: Only one microservice may decrypt sensitive fields.
reasoning.inference: CloudFront field-level encryption encrypts with a public key; only holder of private key decrypts.

reasoning.observation: The edge must not possess the decryption secret.
reasoning.inference: RSA public/private separation gives that boundary.

correct.why: CloudFront FLE uses the uploaded RSA public key while the dedicated service keeps the private key.

alternatives.failsBecause: CloudFront field-level encryption uses an RSA public key profile, not a symmetric KMS key in this design.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits KMS encryption for AWS service data.

alternatives.failsBecause: Lambda@Edge using KMS adds code/permission and is not the native FLE mechanism.
alternatives.whenFits: Fits custom edge transformation when supported.

alternatives.failsBecause: Encrypting with an edge private key exposes the key and reverses the public-key pattern.

examTraps.avoid: Private key must stay with that service.
Field-level encryption, not only TLS.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng encrypt selected request fields; requires RSA key/config.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không thay TLS cho toàn traffic và cần RSA config.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng service-side key management; not interchangeable with CloudFront FLE public key.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không phải symmetric substitute cho CloudFront FLE public-key flow.

serviceBoundaries.useWhen: Dùng edge compute; avoid embedding decryption private key.
serviceBoundaries.notFor: Không nên lưu private key hoặc stateful workflow ở edge.

learningAid.memoryAnchor: CloudFront mã hóa field bằng public key; chỉ microservice giữ private key mới giải mã.

question: A company is planning to migrate its on-premises VMware cluster of 120 VMs to AWS. The VMs have many different operating systems and many custom software packages installed. The company also has an on- premises NFS server that is 10 TB in size. The company has set up a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection to AWS for the migration. Which solution will complete the migration to AWS in the LEAST amount of time?

options.text: Export the on-premises VMs and copy them to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use VM Import/Export to create AMIs from the VM images that are stored in Amazon S3. Order an AWS Snowball Edge device. Copy the NFS server data to the device. Restore the NFS server data to an Amazon EC2 instance that has NFS configured.

Configure AWS Application Migration Service with a connection to the VMware cluster. Create a replication job for the VMS. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure AWS DataSync to copy the NFS server data to the EFS file system over the Direct Connect connection.

Recreate the VMs on AWS as Amazon EC2 instances. Install all the required software packages. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Configure AWS DataSync to copy the NFS server data to the FSx for Lustre file system over the Direct Connect connection.

Order two AWS Snowball Edge devices. Copy the VMs and the NFS server data to the devices. Run VM Import/Export after the data from the devices is loaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Copy the NFS server data from Amazon S3 to the EFS file system.

explanation: Chọn B vì Application Migration Service sao chép nguyên trạng 120 VM với nhiều hệ điều hành/gói tùy chỉnh, còn DataSync chuyển NFS sang EFS qua DX 10 Gbps. Tái tạo thủ công tốn thời gian; Snowball không cần thiết khi có DX nhanh và các phương án dùng VM Import không thuận tiện cho toàn bộ estate.

learningAid.summary: Kết hợp Application Migration Service cho VM và DataSync cho NFS.

translation.stem: Công ty chuyển 120 VMware VM đa dạng và NFS 10 TB, đã có Direct Connect 10 Gbps. Giải pháp hoàn thành nhanh nhất?

options.text: Export VM lên S3/VM Import Export và dùng Snowball cho NFS.
Application Migration Service replicate VMware VM, tạo EFS và DataSync NFS qua Direct Connect.
Tái tạo VM thủ công, tạo FSx for Lustre và DataSync NFS.
Hai Snowball copy VM/NFS, VM Import/Export rồi copy NFS từ S3 sang EFS.

Nền tảng máy ảo tại chỗ
Chuyển file qua network/agent

constraints: Tái tạo thủ công lâu
Snowball không cần với DX nhanh
VM Import nhiều thao tác
focusPoints: Dùng replication cho VM tùy chỉnh.
Chọn công cụ file riêng cho NFS.

question: A company is building an application that will run on an AWS Lambda function. Hundreds of customers will use the application. The company wants to give each customer a quota of requests for a speciﬁc time period. The quotas must match customer usage patterns. Some customers must receive a higher quota for a shorter time period. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.text: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a proxy integration to invoke the Lambda function. For each customer, configure an API Gateway usage plan that includes an appropriate request quota. Create an API key from the usage plan for each user that the customer needs.

Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with a proxy integration to invoke the Lambda function. For each customer configure an API Gateway usage plan that includes an appropriate request quota Configure route-level throttling for each usage plan. Create an API Key from the usage plan for each user that the customer needs.

Create a Lambda function alias for each customer. Include a concurrency limit with an appropriate request quota. Create a Lambda function URL for each function alias. Share the Lambda function URL for each alias with the relevant customer.

Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a VPC. Configure the Lambda function as a target for the ALB. Configure an AWS WAF web ACL for the ALB. For each customer configure a rale-based rule that includes an appropriate request quota.

learningAid.summary: Dùng API Gateway REST usage plans để quota riêng theo khách hàng.

question: A company is planning to migrate several applications to AWS. The company does not have a good understanding of its entire application estate. The estate consists of a mixture of physical machines and VMs. One application that the company will migrate has many dependencies that are sensitive to latency. The company is unsure what all the dependencies are. However the company knows that the low-latency communications use a custom IP-based protocol that runs on port 1000. The company wants to migrate the application and these dependencies together to move all the low-latency interfaces to AWS at the same time. The company has installed the AWS Application Discovery Agent and has been collecting data for several months. What should the company do to identify the dependencies that need to be migrated in the same phase as the application?

options.text: Use AWS Migration Hub and select the servers that host the application. Visualize the network graph to find servers that interact with the application. Turn on data exploration in Amazon Athena. Query the data that is transferred between the servers to identify the servers that communicate on port 1000. Return to Migration Hub. Create a move group that is based on the findings from the Athena queries.

Use AWS Application Migration Service and select the servers that host the application. Visualize the network graph to find servers that interact with the application. Configure Application Migration Service to launch test instances for all the servers that interact with the application. Perform acceptance tests on the test instances. If no issues are identified, create a move group that is based on the tested servers.

Use AWS Migration Hub and select the servers that host the application. Turn on data exploration in Network Access Analyzer. Use the Network Access Analyzer console to select the servers that host the application. Select a Network Access Scope of port 1000 and note the matching servers. Return to Migration Hub. Create a move group that is based on the findings from Network Access Analyzer.

Use AWS Migration Hub and select the servers that host the application. Push the Amazon CloudWalch agent to the identified servers by using the AWS Application Discovery Agent. Export the CloudWatch logs that the agents collect to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the logs to find servers that communicate on port 1000. Return to Migration Hub Create a move group that is based on the findings from the Athena queries.

explanation: Chọn A vì Migration Hub network graph và data exploration xuất dữ liệu sang Athena, nơi có thể lọc các kết nối port 1000 rồi tạo move group. Application Migration Service không phải công cụ phân tích dependency; Network Access Analyzer phân tích đường mạng AWS chứ không đọc dữ liệu discovery on-premises, còn CloudWatch agent không cần thiết.

learningAid.summary: Dùng Migration Hub dependency graph và Athena để tìm port cụ thể.

translation.stem: Công ty đã chạy Application Discovery Agent nhiều tháng, biết app dùng custom protocol port 1000 nhưng chưa biết dependency. Cần xác định server migrate cùng phase. Làm gì?

Nơi nhóm/theo dõi migration
Nhóm server di chuyển cùng nhau

question: A company is creating a sequel for a popular online game. A large number of users from all over the world will play the game within the ﬁrst week after launch. Currently, the game consists of the following components deployed in a single AWS Region: •Amazon S3 bucket that stores game assets •Amazon DynamoDB table that stores player scores A solutions architect needs to design a multi-Region solution that will reduce latency, improve reliability, and require the least effort to implement. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve assets from the S3 bucket. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication. Create a new DynamoDB table in a new Region. Use the new table as a replica target for DynamoDB global tables.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to serve assets from the S3 bucket. Configure S3 Same-Region Replication. Create a new DynamoDB table in a new Region. Configure asynchronous replication between the DynamoDB tables by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with change data capture (CDC).

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and configure origin failover with two origins accessing the S3 buckets in each Region. Configure DynamoDB global tables by enabling Amazon DynamoDB Streams, and add a replica table in a new Region.

Create another S3 bucket in the sine Region, and configure S3 Same-Region Replication between the buckets. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and configure origin failover with two origins accessing the S3 buckets. Create a new DynamoDB table in a new Region. Use the new table as a replica target for DynamoDB global tables.
